description: Calls before initialization are rejected without touching outputs
Initialization produces exactly two ordered low writes and low state
Set channel 0 on and off without disturbing channel 1
Set channel 1 on and off without disturbing channel 0
Every repeated set produces one observable write
Two toggles on each channel return to the starting state
Every invalid uint8_t channel is rejected and leaves state untouched
Queries return stored states without writes or mutations
Null queries are rejected without side effects
Reinitialization resets both nonzero states and repeats low writes
